title: Maikano a yo o iseng a tsholwe
intro: Mowa o o tlhoafetseng o ne o dira tsholofetso e e boitshepo pele ga go goroga ga ngwana. Kgang ya setshwantsho seno e diragala mo teng ga mabota a lefelo le le boitshepo, koo boineelo bo kopanang le kamogelo ya bomodimo gone. Motlhanka yo wa ga Allah ke mang?
clues: Ke ne ke le wa lelapa le le tlotliwang mo Quran.
Ke ne ka ikana ka tlhoafalo gore ke tla neela ngwanake yo o iseng a tsholwe mo tirelong ya ga Allah.
Fa ke belega, ke ne ka gakgamala go fitlhela e le morwadi, le fa ke ne ke solofetse morwa.
Ke ne ka raya ngwanake leina Maryam, leina le le bontshang boineelo le tirelo.
Ke ne ka batla tshireletso ya ga Allah ya ngwanake le ditlogolwana tsa gagwe mo go Satane yo o hutsitsweng.
Ngwanake o ne a amogelwa ke Morena mme a bewa ka fa tlase ga tlhokomelo ya ga Moporofeta Zakariya mo lefelong le le boitshepo.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Mosadi wa ga Imran (Mmaagwe Maryam)
Asiya, mosadi wa ga Faro
Maryam, mmaagwe Isa
Mmaagwe Moporofeti Musa
Kgosigadi ya Sheba

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: A ikana gore o tla neela ngwana wa gagwe mo tempeleng
Go latlhelwa mo molelong
Go kgabaganya lewatle mo lefatsheng le le omileng
Go aga araka e kgolo
Go mediwa ke tlhapi e kgolo
trial.answer: A ikana gore o tla neela ngwana wa gagwe mo tempeleng

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Lefelo le le boitshepo (mihrab) le ngwana wa gagwe a neng a bewa mo go lone
Letlole la kgolagano
Namane ya gauta
Lore lo lo neng lwa fetoga noga
Setlhare sa matala se a neng a ikhutsa ka fa tlase ga sone
location.answer: Lefelo le le boitshepo (mihrab) le ngwana wa gagwe a neng a bewa mo go lone

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ngwana wa gagwe o ne a amogelwa mme a bewa ka fa tlase ga tlhokomelo ya ga Moporofeti Zakariya .
O ne a bolokwa mo kotlhaong ya mogateledi
O ne a newa morwa yo o bidiwang Yahya .
Batho ba gagwe ba ne ba senngwa ke setsuatsue
O ne a nna mohumagadi wa bogosi jo bogolo
outcome.answer: Ngwana wa gagwe o ne a amogelwa mme a bewa ka fa tlase ga tlhokomelo ya ga Moporofeti Zakariya .

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
